en: I greet you, $r.
<The complicated schematics are too much for your meager engineering talents to discern.>
Yeee hawww! Mulverick's fleet is ready to rock. All able bodied Horde soldiers need request a beacon and try their damndest to plant it so that my War Riders can home in for the aerial assault.
Die!  You will not free Myzrael!
Thank you for becoming my next victim!
Thanks for the supplies, $n!
%s inspects the Searing Collar...
With pleasure...
Death is the only escape!
I can make amazing things with the materials I find out here. By Muradin's beard, there are fantastic creatures in these hills! Go have a whack at them, $n, and bring me back some tall tales.

The vessel of rebirth must be fortified with elementium. I know of only one source of the mineral: the elemental planes, at the core of our world.$B$BThere is one, an Earthshaper, who may know more than I about the acquisition of such things. You must find this Earthshaper!
This kodo sure looks nothing like the beast I originally lured!  I wonder if the kombobulator can be used on me.
It seems like love is drifting on the wind. I hope that I won't be left out.
He has to be in the last cell. Unless... they killed him.
Fishing is real easy.  Just take a pole with a line on it, maybe put some bait on it, and cast it out in the water.  Sure enough, them fish will start biting.
Watch, druid. The earth still breathes. It yearns to be cleansed.

Nothing quite like the feel of something dead rubbing up against you.  You can find Shelene Rhobart by heading southeast on the road out of town, and then going east at the intersection.  She's at a small camp there not too far along the road.
Who are the Earthen?
It is a greater knowledge of the ways of the warlock that I crave.
Oh, now I'm pissed!
%s takes in a deep breath...
Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?
NOOOOOOOOOOOO!

Hello, $c. From what I've been told, everything's been collected, and all of the materiel for the war is being shipped over to Silithus as we speak. It should all be there in less than $2113w days. Once that's done, and the gong has been rung with the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, the war will really begin.
Greetings.  Do you seek instruction in art of war?
I keep getting sand stuck in my toes.

Tailor, by trade. 

Here stranger, I'll tell you what. Bring me any spare windstones you come across and I'll share my wares with you. I've got quite the stockpile of Al'Aketh garments here. Say what you will about the insanity of the cult, you've got to admit, they have some sense of style.

Or rather, I do, considering I designed most of their attire.

You desire to shape the bones of the Earth Mother into tools that will aid the Horde.  Good, good.  Follow the path north out of Bloodhoof Village until you come to the elevator leading to the top of Thunder Bluff.  A Bluffwatcher there can give you further assistance.
Farewell to you, and may shadow always protect you!
Do yer part in keepin' the Deeprun Tram clean!
Hey! You better not have gone too far!
What high-stress environments would cause the Earthen to destabilize?
Can you tell me more about this place?
That's it!  No more beer until this mess is sorted out!

A $C is it?  Well, then you will want to speak with Thorfin Stoneshield over in the Dwarven District.  

Oh, and you be sure to tell him that if I step in his pet's business one more time, he's going to be training other hunters from behind bars in the Stockade!
Have you come from the Burning Steppes?  Do you have my black dragon eggs?
Have you heard the one about the ogre, the goblin and the $r?
Thank you, Tirion. What of your identity?
Just sit tight while I get this prepared for you!
So what's this new plague all about?
Greetings.  I'm a female mage trainer, and you're a mage.
Ah yes, Skinning.  There is no one finer in wielding a skinning knife than Yonn Deepcut.  You can find him in the great tent at the northwest corner of the village.
Something needs to be done about the Blackwood tribe.
From yesterday's field trip, Marduk showed us that the dragons will tolerate the meat of recently killed humanoids, but only if they died slowly and painfully.
